name: Card Title
helpText: Header title. Set to 'FDI vs P50', 'FDI vs P90', or 'FDI vs P95' for multi-instance dashboard.

name: FDI Mode
helpText: 'mtd' = month-to-date cumulative forecast vs actual (recommended). 'live' = latest-value DS[0]/DS[1] ratio. 'derived' = single-value vs annual P/365.

name: Forecast Daily Key (P50 / P90 / P95)
helpText: Primary (v4.0): daily P-value key written by pvalue_job. Set per instance: forecast_p50_daily / forecast_p90_daily / forecast_p95_daily. Unit: MWh/day.

name: Actual Daily Energy Key
helpText: Pre-computed daily kWh written by daily_job.py (00:05 local for prior day). Override to a real meter key if available. Unit: kWh/day.

name: Realtime Partial Key (today)
helpText: Realtime kW key used to integrate today's partial generation via agg=SUM. Result divided by 60 to convert kW-min to kWh. Default: active_power.

name: Forecast MTD Key (legacy — ignored in v4.0)
helpText: (legacy — ignored in v4.0) Previously used forecast_p*_mtd precomputed key. No longer read. Retained for 90-day upgrade window so existing dashboard configs do not error on load.

name: Actual Power/Energy Key (legacy — ignored in v4.0)
helpText: (legacy — ignored in v4.0) Previously used as realtime kW key for MTD agg=SUM. Replaced by actualPartialKey. Retained for 90-day upgrade window.

name: Footer Description
helpText: Footer label text. Update to match instance: 'Deviation from P50', 'Deviation from P90', etc.

name: Energy Unit
helpText: Unit displayed in context values.

name: Decimal Places
helpText: Number of decimal places for deviation percentage and values.

name: P50 Daily Key (legacy fallback)
helpText: Fallback if forecastDailyKey is not set. Use forecastDailyKey instead.

name: Forecast Telemetry Key (DS[0], live mode)
helpText: Telemetry key for the P-value daily forecast. Mapped to datasource key [0] in live mode.

name: Actual Telemetry Key (DS[1], live mode)
helpText: Telemetry key for actual daily energy. Mapped to datasource key [1] in live mode.

name: P50 Annual Energy Attribute (derived mode)
helpText: Annual P50 energy (kWh) SERVER_SCOPE attribute. Used in derived mode fallback.

name: Warning Threshold (%)
helpText: Deviation at or above this is MINOR DEVIATION (amber). Default: -5%.

name: Critical Threshold (%)
helpText: Deviation below this is CRITICAL DEVIATION (red). Default: -10%.

name: Accent Color
helpText: Override the border glow accent (CSS color, e.g. #06F5FF). Leave blank for default cyan.

name: Enable Manual Simulation?
helpText: When enabled, uses the manual deviation value below instead of live data.

name: Simulated Deviation %
helpText: Fixed deviation percentage used in manual simulation mode.

name: Invert Colors?
helpText: Enable if positive deviation is bad (flips green/red logic).

name: Tooltip Content (Override)
helpText: Override the dynamic tooltip. Leave empty for auto-generated context.
